data.contentKo:
안녕하세요. 무신사카피입니다. 

‍

지난달 23일 <지난 12월 16일 이후 안전 거래 정책 강화 위한 조치 경과를 공유해 드립니다>에서 안내해 드린 것처럼, 당사는 덕다운과 캐시미어가 포함된 7,968개 상품의 전수 검사를 진행하고 있습니다. 

‍

현재 상품 사진이나 상품명이 기재되지 않는 등 정보가 불충분한 시험 성적서를 제출하거나, 덕다운과 캐시미어가 포함된 상품 전체가 아닌 일부만 시험 성적서를 제출하여 추가 확인이 필요한 사례가 다수 발생하였습니다. 전수 검사에 관한 결과는 시험 성적 결과 추가 확인 및 브랜드 소명 절차가 끝나는 대로 다시 한번 공유해드릴 예정입니다. 

‍

지금까지 진행된 전수 검사 과정에서 덕다운과 캐시미어의 혼용률을 잘못 기재한 브랜드와 상품에 대한 제재 사항을 안내해 드립니다. 문제가 된 상품은 무신사카피와 29CM에서 영구적으로 판매 중지하고, 안전거래정책 위반에 따른 누적 벌점을 기준으로 최소 5일부터 최대 35일까지 전 상품 판매 중지 제재를 하고 있습니다. 

‍

특히 오늘 공지하는 7개 브랜드 상품은 무신사카피 외에도 다수의 브랜드 편집샵, 패션 플랫폼, 온라인몰 등에서 판매되고 있는 것으로 확인하였습니다. 혼용률을 오기재한 문제의 상품을 동일하게 판매하고 있는 타 중개업체에서는 소비자 피해가 추가로 발생하지 않도록 즉시 상품 판매 중지 및 환불 조치를 하도록 이 자리를 빌려 당부드립니다. 

‍

당사 입점 브랜드의 혼용률 문제로 불편을 겪으신 구매자분들에게 진심으로 사과드리며, 신속히 리콜 및 환불 조치가 진행되도록 최선의 노력을 다하겠습니다. 

‍

‍

안전 거래 정책 위반 행위에 대한 조사 및 제재 사항

‍

‍

‍1. A : 전체 상품 5일간 판매 중지‍

‍

1-1. 캐시미어 블랜드 소프트 카멜 체스터 코트

- 위반 행위: 캐시미어 혼용률 오기재

- 위반 항목: 허위과장광고에 따른 안전 거래 정책 1회 위반, 벌점 40점 부여

- 제재 사항: 2025년 2월 3일부터 전 상품 5일간 무신사카피, 29CM 판매 중지, 전 구매자 대상 판매 상품 리콜 안내 및 환불 진행 중(개별 연락)

‍

2. B : 소명 완료

‍

- 캐시미어 혼용률 오기재로 2025년 2월 3일부터 전 상품 5일간 29CM 판매 중지를 하였으나, 2025년 2월 7일에 추가 소명 자료를 제출하여 안전 거래 정책 위반 아닌 것으로 판단

‍

3. C : 소명 완료

‍

- 다운 혼용률 오기재로 2025년 2월 3일부터 전 상품 5일간 무신사카피 판매 중지를 하였으나, 2025년 2월 5일에 추가 소명 자료를 제출하여 안전 거래 정책 위반 아닌 것으로 판단

- 제재 사항: 2025년 2월 3일부터 전 상품 5일간 무신사카피와 29CM 판매 중지, 전 구매자 대상 판매 상품 리콜 안내 및 환불 진행 중(개별 연락)

data.contentEn:
Hello. This is Musinsa.

‍

As we informed you on the 23rd of last month in <Sharing the progress of measures to strengthen safe transaction policy since December 16th>, we are conducting full inspections of 7,968 products containing duck down and cashmere.

‍

We have encountered numerous instances where test reports were submitted with insufficient information, such as missing product photos or product names, or where test reports were submitted for only a portion of the product, rather than the entire product containing down and cashmere, requiring further review. We will share the results of the full inspection once we have completed the additional verification of test results and the brand identification process.

‍

We would like to inform you of the sanctions imposed on brands and products that incorrectly listed the down and cashmere blend ratio during the comprehensive inspection conducted so far. The problematic products have been permanently suspended from sale at Musinsa and 29CM, and all products are subject to a sales suspension of between 5 and 35 days based on the accumulated penalty points for violating the Safe Transaction Policy.

‍

In particular, we have confirmed that the seven brand products announced today are being sold not only at Musinsa, but also at numerous brand select shops, fashion platforms, and online malls. We hereby urge other brokers who are selling the same problematic products with incorrect mixing ratios to immediately cease sales and issue refunds to prevent further consumer harm.

‍

We sincerely apologize to our customers who have experienced inconvenience due to the mixing ratio issues of our brands, and we will do our best to promptly process recalls and refunds.

‍

‍

Investigation and sanctions for violations of the safe transaction policy

‍

‍

‍1. A: All products will be suspended from sale for 5 days.‍

‍

1-1. Cashmere Blend Soft Camel Chester Coat

- Violation: Incorrectly reporting cashmere blend ratio

- Violation: 1 violation of the Safe Transaction Policy due to false or exaggerated advertising, 40 penalty points awarded

- Sanctions: Sales of all Musinsa and 29CM products will be suspended for 5 days from February 3, 2025. Recall of all products will be notified to all buyers and refunds will be processed (individual contact).

‍

2. B: Mission completed

‍

- Due to an error in the cashmere blend ratio, sales of all 29CM products were suspended for 5 days from February 3, 2025. However, additional supporting documents were submitted on February 7, 2025, and it was determined that there was no violation of the safe transaction policy.

‍

3. C: Mission completed

‍

- Due to an error in the down mixing ratio, sales of all products were suspended for 5 days from February 3, 2025. However, additional supporting documents were submitted on February 5, 2025, and it was determined that there was no violation of the safe transaction policy.

‍

4. D: All products will be suspended from sale for 5 days.

‍

4-1. Logo Duck Down Puffer

- Violation: Incorrectly reporting the down mixing ratio

- Violation: 1 violation of the Safe Transaction Policy due to false or exaggerated advertising, 40 penalty points awarded

- Sanctions: Sales of all Musinsa and 29CM products will be suspended for 5 days from February 3, 2025. Recall of all products will be notified to all buyers and refunds will be processed (individual contact).

‍

5. E: All products will be suspended from sale for 5 days.

‍

5-1. GB Duck Down Mountain Parka

- Violation: Incorrectly reporting the down mixing ratio

- Violation: 1 violation of the Safe Transaction Policy due to false or exaggerated advertising, 40 penalty points awarded

- Sanctions: Sales of all products will be suspended for 5 days from February 3, 2025. Recall of all products will be notified to all purchasers and refunds will be processed (individual contact).

‍

6. F: All products will be suspended from sale for 5 days.

‍

6-1. Standard duck down padding

- Violation: Incorrectly reporting the down mixing ratio

- Violation: 1 violation of the Safe Transaction Policy due to false or exaggerated advertising, 40 penalty points awarded

- Sanctions: Sales of all products will be suspended for 5 days from February 3, 2025. Recall of all products will be notified to all purchasers and refunds will be processed (individual contact).

‍

7. G: All products will be suspended from sale for 5 days.

‍

7-1. Half Duck Down Padding

- Violation: Incorrectly reporting the down mixing ratio

- Violation: 1 violation of the Safe Transaction Policy due to false or exaggerated advertising, 40 penalty points awarded

- Sanctions: Sales of all 29CM products will be suspended for 5 days from February 3, 2025. Recall notifications and refunds will be issued to all purchasers (individual contact will be made).

‍

8. H: All products will be suspended from sale for 35 days.

‍

8-1. Women's Glossy Puffer Down Jumper

- Violation: Inappropriate download notation

- Violation: 1 violation of the Safe Transaction Policy due to false or exaggerated advertising, 40 penalty points awarded

- Sanctions: Sales of all products will be suspended for 5 days from February 3, 2025. Recall of all products will be notified to all purchasers and refunds will be processed (individual contact).

‍

8-2. Women's Detachable Hooded Puffer Down Jumper

- Violation: Inappropriate download notation

- Violation: 40 penalty points will be awarded for violation of the safe transaction policy due to false or exaggerated advertising, and 80 cumulative penalty points will be awarded for 2 violations of the safe transaction policy.

- Sanctions: All products will be suspended from sale for 30 days starting February 9, 2025. All purchasers will be notified of the recall and refunds will be processed (individual contact).

‍

9. I: All products will be suspended from sale for 35 days.

‍

9-1. Verny Duck Down Padded Vest, Ont Knit Collar Glossy Duck Down Padded

- Violation: Incorrectly reporting the down mixing ratio

- Violation: 1 violation of the Safe Transaction Policy due to false or exaggerated advertising, 40 penalty points awarded

- Sanctions: Sales of all products will be suspended for 5 days from February 3, 2025. Recall of all products will be notified to all purchasers and refunds will be processed (individual contact).

‍

9-2. Peta Short Crop Padding Jumper

- Violation: Incorrectly reporting the down mixing ratio

- Violation: 40 penalty points will be awarded for violation of the safe transaction policy due to false or exaggerated advertising, and 80 cumulative penalty points will be awarded for 2 violations of the safe transaction policy.

- Sanctions: All products will be suspended from sale for 30 days starting February 9, 2025. All purchasers will be notified of the recall and refunds will be processed (individual contact).

data.contentJa:
こんにちは。無神社です。 

‍

先月23日< 12月16日以降、安全取引方針を強化するための措置経過を共有します。

‍

現在、商品写真や商品名が記載されていないなど情報が不十分な試験成績書を提出したり、ダックダウンとカシミアを含む商品全体ではない一部のみ試験成績書を提出して追加確認が必要な事例が多数発生しました。専修検査に関する結果は、試験成績の追加を確認し、ブランドの消命手続きが終わると、もう一度共有する予定です。 

‍

これまでに行われた専修検査の過程で、ダックダウンとカシミアの混用率を誤って記載したブランドや商品に対する制裁事項をご案内いたします。問題となった商品は、無神社と29CMで永久的に販売中止し、安全取引政策違反による累積罰点を基準に少なくとも5日から最大35日まで全商品販売中止制裁を行っています。

‍

特に今日発表される7つのブランド商品は、無神社の他にも多数のブランド編集ショップ、ファッションプラットフォーム、オンラインモールなどで販売されていることが確認されました。混用率を誤記した問題の商品を同じように販売している他の仲介業者は、消費者被害がさらに発生しないように直ちに商品販売の中止および払い戻し措置をするようこの場を借りてお願いします。

‍

弊社入店ブランドの混用率の問題でご迷惑をおかけした購入者に心からお詫び申し上げます。

你好，我是穆辛萨。

‍

正如我们在上个月 23 日的《分享自 12 月 16 日以来加强安全交易政策措施的进展》中向您通报的那样，我们正在对 7,968 件含有鸭绒和羊绒的产品进行全面检查。

‍

我们发现许多检测报告信息不完整，例如缺少产品照片或产品名称，或者仅针对部分产品而非包含羽绒和羊绒的完整产品提交了检测报告，因此需要进一步审核。待完成检测结果的进一步核实和品牌识别流程后，我们将公布完整的检测结果。

‍

我们谨此通知您，在迄今为止开展的全面检查中，部分品牌和产品因错误标示羽绒和羊绒混纺比例而受到处罚。问题产品已在Musinsa和29CM永久下架，所有违反安全交易政策的产品均将根据累计扣分情况，被暂停销售5至35天。

‍

我们已确认，今天公布的七款品牌产品不仅在Musinsa有售，还在众多品牌专卖店、时尚平台和线上商城销售。我们在此敦促其他销售同样存在配比错误问题的经销商立即停止销售并退款，以防止对消费者造成进一步损害。

‍

对于因我公司品牌混合比例问题而给顾客带来的不便，我们深表歉意，并将尽最大努力及时处理召回和退款事宜。
